import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .cylinder(8.5, 15.5)
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(47.1, 0, 0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .box(64.2, 8.5, 11.5)
    )
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(89.5, 0, 0.0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .cylinder(8.5, 10.8)
    )
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .hole(20.2)
    .cut(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(89.5, 0, 0.0), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .cylinder(12.75, 7.1)
    )
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(47.1, 0, 6.95), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .box(50.56, 8.5, 3.4)
    )
    .union(
        cq.Workplane("XY")
            .transformed(offset=cq.Vector(47.1, 0, -6.95), rotate=cq.Vector(0, 0, 0))
            .box(50.56, 8.5, 3.4)
    )
    .faces(">Y")
    .faces(">Y").workplane()
    .pushPoints([(2.35, 0.0)])
    .hole(2.4)
    .cut(
        cq.Workplane("XZ")
            .pushPoints([(25, 0), (40, 0), (55, 0), (70, 0)])
            .circle(2)
            .extrude(10, both=True)
    )
)
show_object(result)
